messages:
kevin: Postmortem follow-up: we need firm owners on the autoscale/regulator items. Can we triage now?

sophia: I can take the scheduler end-to-end. Plan: A/B test priority classes + maxPodBurst for 48h. Draft config by Mon.

mohit: I'll handle quota policy and coordinate with finance for temporary spike credits. Target headroom suggestion = 20%.

carla: Tracker link: https://go.redwood/incident-2001. I've added owners and a verification checklist.

dana: logging a small concern: last incident showed tail utilization in us-west-2 spiking more than others. We should include zone-level experiments.

ops-bot: [auto] Created task INC-2001-01: Scheduler draft (owner=sophia) due=2026-04-06.

kevin: dana good call. sophia, can your A/B plan include per-zone buckets?

sophia: yes - will run A/B across us-west-2 and eu-west-1 to start.

mohit: finance note: any >15% reserved bump requires approval. For test bursts we can use short-term credits. I'll request it today.

carla: added an alert threshold: zone-tail-util > 76% for 90m -> PD alert. Also added a dashboard for per-zone tail.

kevin: ownership summary: sophia=scheduler tuning (A/B + tests), mohit=quota + finance, carla=tracker+alerts, dana=zone-obs and runbook updates. Deadlines: sophia Mon config, tests Wed-Thu, mohit confirm credits EOD, carla add alert + dashboard.

ops-bot: [reminder] Meeting scheduled: Remediation sync -> 2026-04-04 09:00 UTC.

sophia: config snippet preview:
```
priorityClasses:
  - name: high
    value: 200000
  - name: normal
    value: 1000
maxPodBurst: 15
preemptGracePeriod: 20
```

kevin: nice. Any regressions guardrails? We should fail fast if p999 latency increases > 10%.

sophia: agreed. will include fail-fast automation.

mohit: update: finance approved test credits for 72h. Will post cost cap.

dana: I'll prepare per-zone synthetic traffic profile; will hand it to sophia for A/B.

carla: assigned rollback owner in tracker: dana. Also set weekly recurrence for headroom review for 6 weeks.

kevin: thanks. We'll reconvene after tests and review results. Post updates in the tracker.
